company_introduction.business_archetype: Global pharmaceutical CDMO, primarily project/order delivery with capacity-output manufacturing for small molecule API; emerging new modalities are pipeline/capacity driven.
company_introduction.value_proposition_and_customers: Serves pharmaceutical companies, biotech, and research institutions with end-to-end small molecule CDMO services from starting materials to API and formulation, plus early-stage new modalities including peptides/oligonucleotides, protein/conjugate drugs, and ADC payload-linker services.
company_introduction.revenue_equation: Core project delivery: opening backlog + new orders - delivered/recognized orders = ending backlog; revenue = recognized project/delivery volume x price/mix. Capacity-output businesses: effective capacity x utilization x yield x saleable volume x realized ASP/mix.
company_introduction.profit_equation: Gross profit = revenue - raw materials/direct labor/manufacturing costs; operating profit = gross profit - R&D/selling/admin - impairment/other; parent profit = operating profit - finance costs - tax - minority interest.
company_introduction.cash_flow_equation: OCF = net profit + depreciation/amortization - working-capital change; FCF = OCF - cash paid for long-term assets/capex.
company_introduction.capital_intensity_and_reinvestment: Fixed-asset-intensive CDMO capacity; FY2023-FY2025 fixed assets reported at CNY 2.875bn, 3.073bn, 2.891bn with depreciation CNY 269mn, 311mn, 340mn. Reinvestment includes high-activity facilities and terminates Slovenia project with ~CNY 330mn impairment.
key_unknowns: Order backlog and new order composition by phase/product

New modality capex and time to positive cash flow

competition_and_moat.competition_and_substitution_analysis: Bo Teng competes with larger integrated CDMOs on end-to-end small molecule capability and with specialist ADC/payload players in new modalities. The true peer boundary is not the Tushare industry peer list; it is global CDMO capability for complex molecule development and manufacturing. Customer substitution can be in-house pharma capacity or competing CDMOs; supplier/self-supply risk is highest in commoditized small molecule capacity and lowest in qualified high-activity payload work. New entrants and capacity expansion may pressure price even if demand is growing.
claimed_mechanisms: End-to-end small molecule CDMO capability from starting material to API/formulation
High-activity OEB5 payload-linker capacity in Shanghai and New Jersey
Regulatory qualification and customer qualification/site-locking costs
Specialized capacity and process know-how for complex molecules

key_underwriting_questions.question: What is the final cash and income-statement treatment of the Slovenia R&D production base termination beyond the ~CNY 330mn impairment?
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: The impairment turns H1 2026 reported profit to a guided loss of CNY -250mn to -210mn; residual onerous contracts, asset disposal proceeds, future capex/exit costs, and tax treatment decide whether 2026 reported EPS/FCF are near zero or deeply negative.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: Official H1 guidance confirms ~CNY 330mn impairment and guided H1 loss; H2 and final cash impact unresolved.
bull_evidence: 2026H1 guidance says loss is mainly from the Slovenia project impairment
Ex-impairment H1 parent profit guided CNY 80-120mn
bear_evidence: No disclosed recovery or sale proceeds from Slovenia assets
key_underwriting_questions.next_verification: 2026 interim report cash-flow and impairment notes

key_underwriting_questions.question: Will H1 2026 CDMO order growth of 8%-12% convert into 2027-2028 revenue after current deliveries?
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: This is the core revenue bridge. If the growth is from one-time high-margin deliveries rather than a durable backlog lift, 2027-2028 revenue and operating leverage will fall below the current high PE.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: Company and broker channel checks state new orders and revenue grew well in H1 2026, but no backlog/book-to-bill is supplied.
bull_evidence: CDMO industry peers report strong order growth
Top-15 pharma external capex remains high

key_underwriting_questions.question: Is the Q1 2026 gross margin increase of +4.27pp sustainable and does it reflect structural mix or temporary high-margin product delivery?
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: Gross margin is the main profit bridge; a 1pp move on ~CNY 3.8bn revenue is ~CNY 38mn gross profit, material against FY2025 parent profit of only ~CNY 96mn.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: Q1 2026 gross margin 30.60%, +4.27pp; company attributes H1 clean profit growth to high-margin product delivery and scale effects.
bull_evidence: Official H1 guidance says overall gross margin up ~4pp
Clean H1 profit guided +196%-343% ex impairment
bear_evidence: Q1 operating margin only 2.64%, net margin 3.14%
Q1 OCF/net profit 0.0864 means gross profit did not turn into cash
key_underwriting_questions.next_verification: H1 2026 segment gross margin and revenue mix

key_underwriting_questions.question: When will OCF convert? Q1 2026 OCF/net profit is only 0.0864.
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: Current valuation is equity-rich but profitability is not cash-backed; persistent receivables/inventory-led growth without cash collection would impair FCF and fair value.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: Q1 OCF/net profit 0.0864; receivables/revenue 23.44% and inventory/revenue 22.31% both declined slightly YoY.
bear_evidence: OCF/net profit ratio is extremely low
EFV evidence shows prior 2024 quarterly OCF was negative

key_underwriting_questions.question: Can the new molecule business scale from CNY 68mn revenue without consuming excess capex and fixed cost?
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: The market may be pricing AI4S and new modality optionality; without disclosed orders, utilization, and path to breakeven, this optionality cannot be valued as core FCF.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: 2025 new molecule revenue CNY 68mn, +224%, but ~2% of total. No profit or capacity utilization disclosed.
bull_evidence: High-activity payload capacity exists in Shanghai and New Jersey
key_underwriting_questions.next_verification: Investor interaction and new order announcements

key_underwriting_questions.question: Does AI4S actually produce company-specific order flow, or only industry-wide narrative?
key_underwriting_questions.why_it_matters: AI-driven molecule generation may lift demand for synthesis/testing. If Bo Teng wins these orders, revenue growth can be above base; if not, the current AI4S-driven multiple is unsupported.
key_underwriting_questions.current_answer: Private channel checks cite CDMO beneficiaries including Bo Teng, but there is no company-disclosed AI-related order or revenue.
bull_evidence: North American technology and pharma AI demand reportedly rising
Bo Teng listed as CDMO beneficiary in channel checks
bear_evidence: Beneficiary list is promotional and non-company-specific
key_underwriting_questions.next_verification: Company order announcements or interim segment disclosure
